rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the mosquito-borne disease.

example.english: This mosquito-borne disease is called malaria, so don't take it lightly.
example.traditional: 呢種由蚊傳播嘅病叫瘧疾，唔可以睇少。
